menu.conecteParaUsar: Connect your wallet to see the operations for your registration.
menu.semCadastro: This wallet is not registered with EcolChain. Ask the operator to register it.
menu.desabilitado: Connect your wallet to use this

descricoes.explorar: Look up the trail of any batch, credit or distribution.
descricoes.lotes: Combine source lots of the same material, weigh the consolidated lot and put it up for sale or mark it as sold.
descricoes.anuncios: List batches on the marketplace, reprice or withdraw listings.
descricoes.retiradas: Confirm the custody handover between cooperative and carrier.
descricoes.entregas: Batches in transit and delivery deadlines.
descricoes.marketplace: Lots for sale and at auction by cooperatives and Clean Techs. The industry buys direct sales and bids on auctions.
descricoes.compras: Winning bids and sales awaiting signature.
descricoes.recebimentos: Confirm receipt and the weight on arrival.
descricoes.disputas: Open or follow disputes on your batches.
descricoes.direitos: What you are owed in coupons from sold credits.
descricoes.participantes: Register the wallets of collectors, cooperatives, carriers and industries.
descricoes.balancas: Register the scales of cooperatives and industries.
descricoes.leiloes: Close auctions without bids and record winners.
descricoes.creditos: Build credits from recycled batches and submit them for validation.
descricoes.distribuicoes: Publish the revenue split for each sold credit.
descricoes.escrow: Attest batch escrow deposits, releases and refunds.
descricoes.vendasCredito: Attest receipt of payment for credit sales.
descricoes.repasses: Record transfers to Zupy and EcolChain.
descricoes.validacao: Record issuance or rejection in the official registry.
descricoes.aposentadorias: Record the retirement of sold credits.
descricoes.materiais: Register the material types accepted in batches.
descricoes.coletas: Weigh and record incoming material: from collectors, in-house sorting, donations, purchases or unregistered pickers.
descricoes.meusLotes: The source lots you delivered, at any cooperative, and the path of each one to the industry.
descricoes.minhaCarteira: Your wallet code to show the cooperative at delivery or pickup.
descricoes.painelImportador: Bottles you put on the market and how many have come back for recycling.
descricoes.distribuicoesImportador: Record the bottles you released to the market (invoice or import declaration).
descricoes.coletasImportador: Record the bottles picked up at collection points.
descricoes.entregasImportador: Send collections to a cooperative or Clean Tech.
descricoes.reciclagemImportador: Attach the recycling invoice once the batch is recycled.
descricoes.vendas: Sold lots: buyer, amount, pickup and payment confirmation.

rede.indisponivel: Could not reach {{rede}}. Check your connection or switch networks.

carteira.nenhuma: No Solana wallet found in this browser. Install one (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack) and reload the page.
carteira.erro: The wallet declined the connection. Try again.

painel.boasVindas: Track every batch from collection to recycling and follow what you are owed from carbon credits. LEANDRO LEITE LINDAO
painel.conecte: Connect your wallet to see the operations for your registration.
painel.emDefinicao: The dashboard content is still being defined.

paginas.emConstrucao: This screen is still under construction.

admin.soAdministracao: This screen is only for the platform administration wallet.

materiais.variacoesAjuda: With any variant, every batch of this material states its color and a sale batch never mixes colors. Variants are never deleted: deactivate them.
materiais.semVariacoes: No variants: batches do not state a color.
materiais.contaGarrafasAjuda: Batches state the approximate number of bottles besides the weight.

participantes.nomeAjuda: Shown in lists. It is public on the blockchain: for collectors, prefer a nickname or code.
participantes.referenciaAjuda: E.g.: contract number. Only a code derived from it goes on the blockchain, never the text.
participantes.umPapel: Each wallet has a single role, which cannot be changed later.

balancas.dispositivoAjuda: Public address generated by the device itself.
balancas.semDonos: First register a cooperative or industry in Participants.
balancas.nomeAjuda: Helps find the device in lists. It is public on the blockchain.

erros.generico: The transaction failed. Try again shortly.
erros.semSaldo: Not enough balance in the wallet to pay the fee.
erros.jaExiste: A registration with this data already exists.
erros.NaoEhOperador: This wallet is not the administration wallet.
erros.NomeInvalido: Name is empty or longer than 32 characters.
erros.CarteiraReservada: This wallet is reserved for platform use and cannot be a participant.
erros.PapelIncorreto: The participant does not have the required role.
erros.ParametroInvalido: One of the values is invalid.
erros.BalancaDeOutroDono: The scale belongs to another participant.
erros.PesoConsolidadoForaDaFaixa: The consolidated lot weight is outside the accepted range over the total of the source lots.
erros.EntregaDeOutroLote: One of the source lots belongs to another sale lot.
erros.LoteSemEntregas: The lot has no source lots yet.
erros.EntregaJaVinculada: One of the source lots is already in another sale lot. Refresh and try again.
erros.MaterialDiferente: All source lots must be of the same material as the sale lot.
erros.TransicaoInvalida: This action does not apply to the lot’s current status. Refresh the page.
erros.PesagemDivergente: The weighing signed by the scale does not match the data sent.
erros.carteiraAlterou: The wallet changed the transaction when signing, so the cooperative's signature is no longer valid. Use Solflare or another wallet that signs without changes.
erros.carteiraSemAssinatura: This wallet cannot sign without sending. Use Solflare.
erros.codigoExpirado: The code expired. Ask the cooperative to generate another.
erros.carteiraOutroPapel: The connected wallet is not the one for this role in this sale.
erros.VariacaoObrigatoria: This material has variants: choose the color.
erros.VariacaoInvalida: The variant does not belong to this material.
erros.VariacaoDiferente: Source batches must have the same color as the sale batch.
erros.LimiteDeVariacoes: Variant limit reached for this material.
erros.MaterialSemGarrafas: This material does not count bottles.
erros.CarteiraNaoAutorizada: This wallet is not linked (or was deactivated) to sign for this participant.
erros.CarteiraEmUso: This wallet already belongs to another participant.
erros.ColetaEstadoInvalido: The collection is not at the right stage for this operation.
erros.ColetaDeOutroDestino: This collection was sent to another destination.
erros.ColetaDivergente: Material or color differs from the collection.
erros.LoteNaoReciclado: The sale batch has not been recycled yet.
erros.DataInvalida: Invalid date (empty or in the future).
erros.LoteNaoEhVendaDireta: This lot is not for sale at a fixed price.
erros.LoteEmVendaDireta: This lot is for sale at a fixed price: the industry buys it on the Marketplace.
erros.ModoRetiradaInvalido: Choose who picks up the lot.
erros.RetiradaDeOutroModo: The pickup does not match the mode chosen at purchase (own or by carrier).
erros.ValorAbaixoDoMinimo: The amount is below the lot price.

cooperativa.soCooperativa: This screen is only for cooperative wallets.

coletas.semColetores: No collectors registered. Ask the administration to register collector wallets under Participants.
coletas.balancaNaoPronta: The scale must be registered and active to record source lots.
coletas.referenciaObrigatoria: Invoice, receipt or tax ID. Only a derived code goes on the blockchain. Keep the text: the donor uses it to find the lot in the public trail.
coletas.referenciaOpcional: Optional: ticket or internal note. Only a derived code goes on the blockchain.
coletas.qrInvalido: This QR code is not a wallet. Ask the collector to open "My wallet" in the app.
coletas.qrSemCadastro: This wallet is not registered. Ask the administration to register it as a collector.
coletas.qrNaoColetor: This wallet is registered with another role, not as a collector.
coletas.qrInativo: This collector is inactive. Ask the administration to reactivate it.
coletas.semColetasImportador: No importer collection on its way to this unit.

lotes.semBalanca: Generate the test scale in Source lots before assembling lots.
lotes.evidenciasAjuda: Invoice, receipt or scale ticket number. Only a code derived from it goes on the blockchain; with the text, anyone can find the lot in the public trail.
lotes.escolherEntregas: Available source lots of this material
lotes.semEntregas: No source lots of this material available.
lotes.pesoFardo: Consolidated lot weight on the scale (kg)
lotes.pesoFardoAjuda: Accepted from {{min}} to {{max}} kg. Empty uses the total.
lotes.passo: Sending {{n}} of {{total}}… confirm in your wallet.
lotes.foraDaFaixa: Outside the accepted range: {{min}} to {{max}} kg.
lotes.desfazerTexto: The {{n}} source lot(s) become available for another sale lot and the lot’s digital receipt is burned. After the sale, it can no longer be undone.

trilha.buscaExemplo: E.g.: Collector 1, invoice 1234, receipt 88 or a lot address
trilha.ajuda: Type the name of a collector, cooperative or industry to see its lots. With a donation or sale receipt, type the reference as it appears on the document (invoice, receipt or tax ID); case and extra spaces do not matter. A lot or wallet address also works.
trilha.nada: Nothing found with that name, reference or address.
trilha.naoVinculado: Not in a sale lot yet.
trilha.origens: Source lots that make up this lot
trilha.naoConsumido: Not consumed by the industry yet.
trilha.erro: Could not reach the blockchain right now. Try again in a moment.
trilha.limite: Showing {{n}} of {{total}} results. Refine the search to see the rest.

coletor.soColetor: This screen is for wallets registered as collectors.
coletor.vazio: No source lot registered with your wallet yet.

leitorQr.aponte: Point at the QR code on the collector's "My wallet" screen
leitorQr.semCamera: Could not open the camera. Allow camera access in the browser (the page must be on https) or pick the collector from the list.

minhaCarteira.soParticipante: This screen is for wallets registered as collector or carrier.
minhaCarteira.ajudaColetor: Show this code to the cooperative when you deliver or sell material. They scan it and the source lot is registered in your name. The code carries only the wallet address, no personal data.
minhaCarteira.ajudaTransportador: This code identifies your wallet. To pick up a lot, use "Pickups › Pickup code", which also carries the MTR number.

retiradas.soParticipante: This screen is for wallets registered as cooperative, Clean Tech, carrier or industry.
retiradas.selecione: Select a lot waiting for pickup
retiradas.vazioCooperativa: No sold lot waiting for pickup.
retiradas.vazioTransportador: No lot picked up with your wallet yet. Tap "Sign pickup" at the cooperative.
retiradas.passo1: Read the code of whoever will take the lot to {{industria}}. The carrier generates it in "Pickups › Pickup code", with the MTR number.
retiradas.qrNaoCarteira: This is not a pickup code. Ask them to open "Pickups" in the app, tap "Pickup code" and enter the MTR.
retiradas.qrSemCadastro: This wallet is not registered. Ask the administration to register it as a carrier.
retiradas.qrNaoTransportador: This wallet is registered with another role, not as a carrier.
retiradas.qrInativo: This carrier is inactive. Ask the administration to reactivate it.
retiradas.passo2: The cooperative has signed. Now {{nome}} opens "Pickups" in the app, taps "Sign pickup" and scans this code.
retiradas.qrTitulo: Pickup code for the carrier to sign
retiradas.expirado: The code expired (it is valid for about one minute). Generate another and ask the carrier to scan again.
retiradas.concluida: Pickup of lot #{{lote}} registered. The lot is with {{nome}}.
retiradas.aponte: Scan the code shown on the cooperative's screen, under "Register pickup".
retiradas.efeito: By signing, you take custody of the lot and the digital receipt moves to your wallet. The delivery deadline to the industry is already running.
retiradas.confirmada: Pickup signed. The lot is with you.

qr.formato: This is not an EcolChain pickup code. Scan the code on the cooperative's "Register pickup" screen.
qr.outroTransportador: This code was generated for another carrier. Ask the cooperative to choose your wallet.
qr.jaRetirado: This lot is no longer waiting for pickup.
qr.assinaturaInvalida: The code does not match the cooperative's signature. Ask them to generate another code.

retiradas.aponteTransportador: Point at the code on the screen of whoever picks up
retiradas.aponteCamera: Point at the code on the cooperative's screen
retiradas.passo1Propria: At purchase, {{industria}} chose to pick up the lot itself. Read the code generated in "Pickups › Pickup code" by whoever came, with the MTR number.
retiradas.qrNaoCompradora: This wallet does not belong to the industry that bought the lot.
retiradas.vazioIndustria: No purchases with own pickup. When you buy choosing "Own carrier", the lot appears here so you can sign the pickup at the cooperative.
retiradas.mtrAjuda: Waste Transport Manifest (MTR) of this load: up to 6 digits.
retiradas.codigoRetiradorPasso: Enter the MTR number of this load and show the code to the cooperative, in "Register pickup". Then tap "Sign pickup" and read the code it generates.
retiradas.codigoRetiradorMostrar: Show this code to the cooperative. It carries your wallet and MTR {{mtr}}.
retiradas.mtrNoCodigo: MTR {{mtr}}, entered by whoever picks up, is recorded on the lot.

vendas.vazioCompras: No purchase registered with your wallet yet.
vendas.passo1: Lot from {{cooperativa}}. Minimum price: {{minimo}}. Enter the auction result; then the payment intermediary and the industry check and sign.
vendas.depositoAjuda: Given by the intermediary (e.g. Pix id). Only a derived code goes on the blockchain.
vendas.ataAjuda: E.g. minutes number. Only a derived code goes on the blockchain.
vendas.passo2: The administration has signed. Now the intermediary, in "Lot escrow", and the industry, in "Purchases", read this code (camera or copy and paste) and sign. The code is valid for about one minute: keep the three screens open before you start.
vendas.qrTitulo: Sale code for the next signatures
vendas.aguardando: Waiting for the intermediary's and the industry's signatures…
vendas.expirado: The code expired before the three signatures (it is valid for about one minute). Generate another one and pass it right away to the intermediary and the industry.
vendas.concluida: Sale of lot #{{lote}} registered: {{nome}}, {{valor}}. The lot is waiting for pickup.
vendas.lerCodigo: Read the sale code, generated by the administration in "Auctions" or by the intermediary.
vendas.conferindo: Checking the code on the blockchain…
vendas.efeitoIndustria: By signing, you buy the lot for this value. The delivery deadline starts when the sale is registered.
vendas.efeitoIntermediador: By signing, you attest that the value is deposited in escrow with this reference.
vendas.assinadoProximo: Signed. Missing: {{quem}}. Show this code (QR or copy and paste).
vendas.soIntermediador: This screen is for the payment intermediary wallet.
vendas.soIndustria: This screen is for wallets registered as industry.

codigo.formato: This is not an EcolChain sale code.
codigo.assinaturaInvalida: The code does not match the signatures. Ask the administration for a new code.
codigo.vencido: The code expired (it is valid for about one minute). Ask the administration for a new code.
codigo.naoAnunciado: This lot is no longer in auction.
codigo.jaAssinado: Your wallet has already signed this code. Pass it to whoever is missing.

vendas.aguardaPrazoLances: This auction has bids: the sale is recorded after the deadline, to the highest bid.
vendas.vencedorLances_one: Auction with {{count}} bid on the blockchain: the sale goes to the industry with the highest bid, at its amount.
vendas.vencedorLances_other: Auction with {{count}} bids on the blockchain: the sale goes to the industry with the highest bid, at its amount.

balancaTeste.semBalanca: To weigh, {{quem}} needs a scale. On devnet, use a test scale generated in this browser.
balancaTeste.naoCadastrada: Scale not registered yet. Ask the administration to register it in Scales, with {{quem}} as owner.
balancaTeste.outroDono: This scale is registered to another wallet.
balancaTeste.inativa: Scale registered, but deactivated by the administration.
balancaTeste.pronta: Scale registered and active. Ready to weigh.
balancaTeste.aviso: Test scale: the key is stored in this browser. In real operation, the device itself signs each weighing.

recebimentos.vazio: No lot on the way or received.
recebimentos.faixaValor: from {{min}} to {{max}} kg ({{tol}}% tolerance, set at the sale)
recebimentos.divergente: Outside the tolerance: on registering, the lot goes to dispute for weight divergence and the arbiter decides. The material stays with the industry.
recebimentos.comBalanca: Weighing attested by the industry scale
recebimentos.comBalancaAjuda: The scale signs the weight and the time; the receipt is marked as attested.
recebimentos.semBalanca: No scale ready: the weight is recorded as informed, without attestation.
recebimentos.registrado: Receipt of lot #{{lote}} recorded. The digital receipt moved to your wallet; the payment to the cooperative is still to be released.
recebimentos.emDisputa: Receipt of lot #{{lote}} registered with weight divergence: the lot is in dispute.

escrow.selecione: Select a lot received by the industry
escrow.vazioAguardando: No received lot waiting for release.
escrow.referencia: Reference of the transfer to the cooperative
escrow.referenciaAjuda: E.g. id of the Pix sent. Only a derived code goes on the blockchain.
escrow.efeito: By signing, you attest that you transferred the held amount to the cooperative. The lot becomes Recycled and can join a carbon credit.
escrow.liberado: Payment of lot #{{lote}} released: {{valor}} to {{nome}}. The lot is Recycled.

material.garrafasAjuda: Approximate count; weight remains the official measure.
material.garrafasInvalidas: Enter a whole number of bottles.

carteiras.explicacao: Each wallet has a name and signs for the participant (front desk, driver, gate). A wallet belongs to one participant only. Only the holder or the administration add and deactivate wallets.
carteiras.enderecoAjuda: Ask for the QR on the My wallet screen or paste the address.
carteiras.nomeAjuda: Shown to operators; do not use personal data.

importador.soImportador: This screen is for the importer. Connect the importer's wallet (holder or linked).
importador.pesoEstimadoAjuda: Optional. The receiver's scale weight is what counts.
importador.distribuicoesAjuda: Each distribution batch records bottles you put on the market, with the invoice or import declaration. It is the base of the recovery rate.
importador.coletasAjuda: Record the bottles picked up. Then send the collection to a cooperative or Clean Tech, which weighs it and records the source batch.
importador.dataFutura: The date cannot be in the future.
importador.semMaterialGarrafas: No active material counts bottles. Ask the administration to enable "counts bottles" on Glass.

distribuicao.referenciaAjuda: Only the hash of the number goes on-chain; anyone holding the document finds the batch in the trail.

coleta.referenciaAjuda: Store, building, event… Stored only as a hash (privacy).

importador.escolherDestino: Choose the cooperative or Clean Tech
importador.semDestinos: No active cooperative or Clean Tech.
importador.enviarEfeito: The destination sees the collection when recording the source batch and weighs it on its own scale.
importador.semPendentes: No collection waiting to be sent.
importador.entregasAjuda: Collections still with you or on their way. If the destination refuses, cancel and choose another.
importador.nfSoReciclado: Available once the sale batch is recycled.
importador.nfRegistrada: Invoice recorded. The collection is recycled.
importador.reciclagemAjuda: Collections already weighed by the destination. Once their sale batch is recycled, attach the recycling invoice.

painel.pendentes: {{envio}} waiting to send · {{caminho}} on the way
painel.porMesAjuda: Distributed by invoice date; collected and recycled by collection date.
painel.porCorAjuda: Percentage: recycled ÷ distributed of the same color.
painel.vazio: No distributions or collections yet. Start with Distribution batches.

venda.selecione: Select a closed lot to put up for sale or mark as sold
venda.aVendaAjuda: Shown on the Marketplace to industries. The first one to buy at the price (or more) gets it.
venda.vendidoAjuda: Already sold outside the platform. Recorded with no amount and no buyer.
venda.valorAjuda: Total price of the lot, not per kilo. To change it later, open this window again.
venda.semEntregas: This lot has no source lots, so it cannot be put up for sale.
venda.soParticipante: This screen is for wallets registered as cooperative, Clean Tech or industry.
venda.disputaIndustria: Lots for sale by cooperatives and Clean Techs. For a direct sale, select the lot and tap "Buy": first come, first served. For an auction, tap "Place bid" and enter the amount; the highest bid at the deadline wins.
venda.disputaCooperativa: All lots for sale on the network, at a fixed price or at auction, yours and other cooperatives'. To put a lot up for sale or change its price, use "Sale lots".
venda.vazioDisputa: No lots for sale or at auction right now.
venda.valorCompraAjuda: Asking price: {{preco}}. You can offer more.
venda.abaixoDoPreco: The amount cannot be lower than the asking price ({{preco}}).

modo.terceiroAjuda: A registered carrier collects the lot at the cooperative.
modo.propriaAjuda: The industry itself collects the lot and signs the pickup in "Pickups".

venda.efeitoCompra: Payment is arranged directly with the cooperative. After receipt, it confirms the payment and the lot is completed.
venda.selecionePagamento: Select a lot received by the industry and not yet paid
venda.pagamentoConfirmado: Payment confirmed. The lot is completed.
venda.comprovanteAjuda: Pix ID, bank slip or invoice number. Only the hash goes on-chain.
venda.efeitoPagamento: On confirming, the lot becomes Recycled and can join a carbon credit.
venda.lanceDepois: The bid is recorded on the blockchain and everyone sees the highest amount. When the auction ends, the administration records the sale to the highest bid and your industry receives the code to review and sign in "Purchases".
venda.lanceEncerrado: The auction has ended and no longer takes bids. The administration records the sale to the highest bid.
venda.lanceRegistrado: Bid of {{valor}} on lot #{{id}} recorded on the blockchain. You lead the auction.
venda.lanceAjuda: Total amount for the lot. You can raise your bid until the auction ends.
venda.abaixoDoMinimoLance: The bid cannot be lower than the minimum ({{minimo}}).
venda.lanceNaoSupera: The bid must be higher than the current highest bid ({{maior}}).
venda.voceLideraAjuda: Your bid is the highest so far. You can raise it if you wish.
venda.lanceVenceu: The auction has ended and your bid is the highest. Wait for the administration to record the sale: the signing code arrives in "Purchases".
venda.lanceEncerradoSemLances: The auction ended with no bids.
venda.selecioneLeilaoProprio: Select one of your lots at auction
venda.lancesAjuda: Bids of the current round, highest first. Each industry has one bid, which it can only raise. The sale goes to the top bidder after the deadline.

contestacoes.soParte: This screen is for the parties of the lots: cooperative, Clean Tech, industry and carrier.
contestacoes.explicacao: Lots you are a party to, from the sale until the payment is released. If the weight, grading or delivery is not right, open a claim: the lot stops and the arbitrator decides. Evidence (photos, tickets, messages) goes to the arbitrator outside the platform; the blockchain keeps the reason.
contestacoes.naoContestavel: This lot cannot be claimed now (outside the sale-to-release steps, or already ruled at this step)
contestacoes.prazoAcionado: The delivery deadline of lot #{{lote}} expired: the lot went to claim.
contestacoes.vazio: None of your lots in this situation.

motivoAjuda.divergenciaPeso: The weighed amount does not match the record.
motivoAjuda.classificacao: The material is not as advertised (type, color or contamination).
motivoAjuda.falhaEntrega: The lot was not picked up, delivered, or arrived damaged.
motivoAjuda.outro: Any other problem; explain it to the arbitrator.

contestacoes.efeito: The lot stays under claim until the arbitrator decides. Once the arbitrator rules on a step, it cannot be claimed again.
contestacoes.aberta: Claim on lot #{{lote}} opened. The arbitrator will review it.

arbitragem.soArbitro: This screen is for the arbitrator's wallet.
arbitragem.explicacao: Lots under claim. Proceed returns the lot to the step it was at (and may correct the weight): only the arbitrator signs. Partial release and Refund move the held money: the arbitrator signs and generates a code, and the intermediary reviews and signs on the Lot escrow screen.

ajuda.prosseguir: The lot returns to "{{etapa}}" and continues. Before delivery, the deadline is renewed.
ajuda.liberar: Closes the sale: part of the amount goes to the cooperative and the rest returns to the industry. The lot goes to Recycled.
ajuda.liberarSoRecebido: Only for claims opened after receipt.
ajuda.reembolsar: Closes the sale and returns the full amount to the industry. The lot goes to Refunded.

arbitragem.novoPesoAjuda: Leave blank to keep the current weight.
arbitragem.valorLiberadoAjuda: Up to {{valor}}. The rest returns to the industry.
arbitragem.referenciaAjuda: Pix or transfer ID. Only the hash goes to the blockchain.
arbitragem.vendaDireta: Direct sale: there is no escrow; the intermediary co-signs only to record the decision.
arbitragem.comIntermediador: The intermediary reviews and signs on the Lot escrow screen, on their own device.
arbitragem.passoIntermediador: Decision signed. Show the code to the intermediary: they review and sign at "Lot escrow" › "Sign decision".
arbitragem.lerCodigo: Scan the decision QR on the arbitrator's device or paste the code.
arbitragem.efeitoIntermediador: By signing, you attest that you made these transfers of the held money.

codigo.formato: This code is not an arbitrator decision.
codigo.outroIntermediador: This wallet is not the intermediary's.
codigo.assinaturaInvalida: The arbitrator's signature does not match.
codigo.semDisputa: This lot is no longer under claim.
